PX68K libretro core
===================
Upstream: https://github.com/libretro/px68k-libretro
Commit:   0ad84d7058a12b7db4f7f7a906e87fad4e2f26f6
Vendored: 2026-10-25

This directory is upstream source plus a small set of VGM logging hooks.
See HEADLESS_PATCH.md for the exact local changes; emulation code is
otherwise untouched.

License: GNU GPL v2 (see COPYING).

The emulator ROMs (iplrom.dat / cgrom.dat) are NOT included and must be
supplied by the user.
